items.name: claudemy
items.description: Claudemy: an open-source alternative to Udemy and Coursera. Give Claude a topic, it researches the web and builds a course of 2-minute audio lessons with cited sources. A free Claude Code skill.

items.name: Lampline
items.description: Build AI phone agents on your own computer and test every change with an AI caller. Open source, runs free with no API keys, cents per call with your own keys. Imports Dialogflow CX.

items.name: ai-promo-video-maker
items.description: 一句话让 AI 帮你做产品宣传片！把产品名或网址告诉 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程工具，它会自己调研产品、画出多种风格样图让你挑选、截取 4K 真实页面、按音乐节拍卡点剪辑、生成 AI 旁白并逐句转写校验、自动审图，最后交付一支 4K 商业宣传视频和可在线播放的网页版。App、网站、SaaS、开源项目、课程、AI 模型都能做，你只需确认需求、试听配乐。不用学剪辑软件，也不用花钱找外包。基于 Remotion + ElevenLabs，可直接克隆使用，也能一键安装为 Agent Skill。

items.name: voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi
items.description: Turkish voice design with VoxCPM2 on a 4 GB GPU: describe a voice, pick a variant, read text in 30 languages. Patched audio.cpp, local UI in 30 languages, 14 ready-made voices.

items.name: OpenAmika
items.description: OpenAmika: MekaHime's AI companion Amika, open source. Live2D avatar, real-time voice, long-term memory, OpenRouter or Ollama brain.

items.name: AudioSmith
items.description: Speech, voices, stories, audiobooks, dubbing and transcription, made on your Mac. Free and open source.

license.name: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0

items.name: NPCTalk
items.description: Make any NPC in any game talk back with Fish Audio: skills, a self-hosted voice server and tools for AI coding agents, with a full GTA V example.

items.name: speech-studio
items.description: Free offline AI voice studio for Windows — text-to-speech with cloned and built-in voices, and speech recognition with speakers. Russian done right. 100% local, one native .exe, zero Python.

items.name: otopilot
items.description: Turn a topic into a finished YouTube Short/video: script, free & CC0 images, voice-over, subtitles, thumbnail. Runs locally, no key needed. Use with Claude Code / Codex. 15-language UI. MIT

items.name: ComfyUI-Drama3
items.description: Fish Audio Drama 3 text to speech, natively in ComfyUI: voice cloning, dialogue and inline cues on cards from 8 GB, plus a native Qwen3-ASR. Built with Fish Audio.
